messages:
anna-product: Quick design review 0000000000000000000pushed an updated modal for retention + encryption. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Need decisions on: CTA order in the save dialog, short KMS label for compact headers, and how region fallback is communicated for compliance flows. PTAL.

sam-design: Nice polish overall. Nits: 1) CTA placement 00000000000000primary right vs left? Consistency with console matters. 2) KMS label 0000000long in a small pill; propose trying 'Key ownership' + short values or 'Customer key'. Hover-expander for full phrase.

marta-ux: Accessibility: prefer primary on the right if focus lands on first interactive; recommended focus order: region select -> retention -> key pill -> Save. Add aria-describedby on the KMS pill pointing to hint text. Propose pill labels: 'Key ownership' with values 'Hosted' / 'Customer' / 'Pending' for clarity.

leo-frontend: Implementation notes: pill has 3 states. Need accessible color tokens. Current green (#26c281) fails contrast. Region dropdown: when org has fallback rules we now show 'Auto (EU)' which is ambiguous to screen readers. Suggest explicit label 'EU (fallback)' and a tooltip that explains fallback policy. Also beware of truncation in narrow view.

tim-eng: Contrast check: #26c281 on #ffffff ~3.8:1 -> fails WCAG AA. Darken to #148b5c for >=4.5:1. I'll update token in components. For KMS 'pending' state add aria-live="polite" on the pill so SRs get updates when key provisioning completes; add small debounce to avoid repeated announcements. Also recommend role="status" on the hint region.

anna-product: Copy: Audit log entries should show actor. Change 'Key rotated' -> 'KMS: Customer key rotated by @username' (short: 'KMS: Customer key rotated by <user>'). Retention presets: current names sound technical/scary. Proposed: 'Strict (30 days)', 'Balanced (90 days)', 'Keep indefinitely' (avoid 'Infinite'). Also show retention summary in small text under preset.

sam-design: +1 on 'Keep indefinitely'. For timestamps show local time with UTC offset in tooltip (e.g., 'Mar 12, 2026 14:23 PDT (UTC-7)'). Change BYOK lock icon to outlined shield+key to better communicate ownership vs encryption state.

deploybot: deploybot: preview built and deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.example/design-previews/1765432100  components updated, color tokens migrated. :white_check_mark:

marta-ux: I'll drop a short a11y checklist and the copy updates into Figma: focus order, aria labels/descriptions, color swatches with contrast ratios, aria-live notes, and keyboard-only walkthrough steps. I'll also add a SR-specific hint on the region dropdown indicating fallback behavior.

anna-product: Thanks! Can we aim to open the dev PR by Friday and plan a small release Monday if no regressions? I'll loop in @eng-release and write rollout notes. :pray:
